regression_investigation.identity_only: Exposed firmware Device Check0 stall at7624/7629, PSNS8a polled12204444 times; SCSI-backed state test correctly failed its non-silence assertion twice
regression_investigation.pio_only: Advanced to missing DMA47, INTS0 polled7959420 times; state test still failed
regression_investigation.complete_fix: Present target is identified as Unformatted, firmware rejects it and recovers; SCSI-backed cold replay and non-silence/release assertions pass

limits: Successful original-firmware SCSI sample Load requires a genuine supported filesystem fixture and remains unqualified
DMA47 is synchronous bounded SPC-input-to-RAM only; other DMA controls, output transfers, zero-count conventions, native IRQ priority and physical timings are not qualified
Scan command trace is bounded and drops rows in present-target cases; no exhaustive bus/arbitration claim. Completed DMA47 is additionally observed in private MAME -log output
Absent-target case displays No Drive and recovers; its late command trace is empty, so no claim that every absent ID is reselected by that UI action
Firmware display assertions use visually reviewed OS2.24 pixel signatures, not OCR or generalized text recognition
No SCSI Save/writeback/hot-plug or final-package/DAW acceptance added
System SavePRM is backup memory, not disk activity; concurrent disk/MIDI/voice gate remains open
